task.title: To open an agreement in Contract Management

step.cmd: Open the agreement document for the agreement you want to view.
From the X-Author menu, hover over the menu icon and click X-Author Contracts.
Under the X-Author Contracts pane, click the Work tab.
In the Work tab, click more icon and select Open in CLM.

postreq.p: A separate browser window is opened and the agreement is loaded in Contract Management (You may be prompted to log in again to your Contract Management account in the browser).
